title: Verify in game: request rows at pull, Exorcism cooldown, chat-lockdown DI announce
description: 4.3.1 untested: no 'Interface action failed' with a request row up at pull; Exorcism/HoW icon dark during cooldown; DI announce shows locally when chat is locked.

title: Verify in game: buff key fires once with AnyDown+AnyUp
description: 4.3.1 registers the buff key for both phases with a PreClick guard on ActionButtonUseKeyDown. Check one press casts and prints once, setting on and off.

title: Sync: no full RequestSync on every loading screen
description: Group.lua PLAYER_ENTERING_WORLD triggers RequestSync (SELF + all LB syncers + REQ, every paladin answers). Only on login/GROUP_JOINED.

title: Buff key: skip SetAttribute when macrotext is unchanged, stop ticker when disabled
description: PartyBuff.lua 2s ticker scans up to 40 units x 40 auras and rewrites macrotext every time. Skip unchanged attributes, stop when pbEnabled is off, consider raid UNIT_AURA with updateInfo.

title: Shared player-aura read cached per UNIT_AURA
description: Six modules call ns.ReadPlayerBuffs on every player UNIT_AURA (40 pcalls each) plus the Blessings 1s ticker. Cache in Core, invalidate on UNIT_AURA player / combat change.

title: Cleanse: repaint range on the ticker instead of rescanning every unit's auras
description: Cleanse.lua:711 ticker (0.5s) calls M:Update, which rescans up to 40x40 auras plus Units()/GetRaidRosterInfo, even in list mode at alpha 0. Use UNIT_AURA (updateInfo) for debuffs and only refresh range on the ticker; consider HARMFUL|RAID filter.

title: Feature: announce assignments to raid chat
description: Button in the Blessings window that posts each paladin's row to raid chat, like PallyPower.

title: PartyBuff: prune the recent/recentLen GUID tables
description: Fallback cast times are never cleared; drop entries older than 15 min.

title: Cooldowns: CDS broadcast on every SPELLS_CHANGED
description: Cooldowns.lua:387 schedules a CDS send on each SPELLS_CHANGED. Only send when the cooldown data changed.

title: Blessings ticker runs while the module is disabled or hidden
description: Blessings.lua:139 NewTicker(1) calls M:Update (reads player auras) regardless of the setting or frame visibility.

title: Trackers: Holy Shock icon keeps the 0.2s ticker running out of combat
description: The Holy Shock icon is shown out of combat, so frame:IsShown() is always true for Holy paladins and the Trackers ticker never idles.

title: Feature: optional whisper reply to blessing requests
description: e.g. Kings coming / out of range.

title: Feature: Lay on Hands in the cooldowns list, and age of each peer's data
Feature: overview tooltip lists who is missing the blessing
description: Row tooltip in the class overview.

title: Tanks: 4.3 receivers see a tank named '-' when the leader clears the list
description: TANKS - is parsed as a name by 4.3. Goes away as people update.
